mapper.update: UPDATE LECTURE_REQUEST SET lecture_id = #{lecture_id}, request_name = #{request_name}, birthday = #{birthday}, gender = #{gender}, phone_number = #{phone_number}, email = #{email}, zip_code = #{zip_code}, address1 = #{address1}, address2 = #{address2}, request_status = #{request_status}, complete_yn = #{complete_yn} WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND request_id = #{request_id}
